source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 15 (PDF 45-60), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Physical Optics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Who first proposed the wave nature of light, and which experiment established it?
(Light ki wave nature sab se pehle kis ne pesh ki, aur kis tajurbe ne ise sabit kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Christiaan Huygens ne 1678 mein light ki wave nature (lehri fitrat) pesh ki. 1801 ke Young ke interference tajurbe ne ise sabit kar ke Huygens ki wave theory qaim ki.

book_ref.quote: The wave nature of light was first proposed in 1678 by Christiaan Huygens

blocks.prompt:
2 What is meant by the dual nature of light?
(Light ki dual nature (dohri fitrat) se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Light tajurbe ke mutabiq wave aur particle dono khasiyatein dikhati hai. Yeh electromagnetic wave ki tarah chalti hai magar maadde se photons (be-mass zarraat) ki shakal mein amal karti hai.

book_ref.quote: the quantum mechanical explanation revealed the dual nature of light

blocks.prompt:
3 How, according to Maxwell, are electromagnetic waves produced?
(Maxwell ke mutabiq electromagnetic waves kaise paida hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Maxwell (1860) ne light ko electromagnetic waves samjha. Oscillating (jhoolte) charges badalte electric aur magnetic fields banate hain jo aik doosre ko dobara paida karte hain aur vacuum mein bhi chal sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: the oscillating electric charges can produce changing electric and magnetic fields

blocks.prompt:
4 Why was Newton's corpuscular theory of light more accepted than Huygens' wave theory at first?
(Shuru mein Newton ki corpuscular theory Huygens ki wave theory se zyada maqbool kyun thi?)
blocks.explanation: Jab Huygens ne 1678 mein wave theory pesh ki to us ke haq mein tajurbati saboot qaail karne wala nahi tha, is liye 1801 ke Young ke tajurbe tak Newton ki corpuscular theory (1672) zyada maqbool rahi.

book_ref.quote: The experimental evidence in support of wave theory at that time was not convincing.

blocks.prompt:
5 Define wavefront.
(Wavefront ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Wavefront aik khayali satah hai jo un tamam points ko jorti hai jahan lehron ka phase (marhala) aik jaisa ho. Lagataar wavefronts ka kam se kam faasla wavelength ke barabar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A wavefront is an imaginary surface that connects all the points where the waves have the same phase.

blocks.prompt:
6 Name the three types of wavefronts with one example of each.
(Wavefronts ki teen qismein aik aik misal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Plane wavefronts: door ke sitaron ki light, ripple tank ke seedhe vibrator ki lehrein. (2) Circular wavefronts: talab ke paani ki lehrein. (3) Spherical wavefronts: teen-jihati jagah mein point source ki awaz ya light.

book_ref.quote: Wavefronts can be of three types:

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a ray? How is it related to the wavefront?
(Ray kya hai? Iska wavefront se kya talluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ray (shua) wavefront par amood line hai jo us ke chalne ki simt dikhati hai. Lehar ki energy ray ke saath, wavefront par har point par amood, muntaqil hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A line at right angle to a wavefront which shows its direction of travel is called a ray

blocks.prompt:
8 Why can the wavefronts of sunlight be taken as plane at the surface of the earth?
(Sooraj ki light ke wavefronts zameen ki satah par plane kyun maane ja sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sooraj bohat zyada door hai. Bohat bare spherical wavefront ka chhota hissa taqreeban seedha (flat) hota hai, is liye zameen par yeh wavefronts plane maane ja sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: For very large distances, like light rays coming from sun, these wavefronts can be assumed as planes

blocks.prompt:
9 How can plane wavefronts of light be produced in the laboratory?
(Lab mein light ke plane wavefronts kaise banaye ja sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Light ke point source ko convex lens ke focal point par rakhein. Source ke spherical wavefronts lens ki doosri taraf plane wavefronts ban kar nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: If a source of light is placed at the focal point of a lens. Plane wavefronts are formed

blocks.prompt:
10 In a ripple tank, successive plane wavefronts are 1.5 cm apart. What is the wavelength, and how far is the 9th wavefront from the 1st?
(Ripple tank mein lagataar plane wavefronts 1.5 cm door hain. Wavelength kya hai, aur 9th wavefront 1st se kitna door hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wavefronts ka kam se kam faasla wavelength hai, is liye λ = 1.5 cm. 1st se 9th tak 8 faasle: 8 × 1.5 = 12 cm.

book_ref.quote: The shortest distance between wavefronts is always equal to wavelength of wave.

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between plane and spherical wavefronts.
(Plane aur spherical wavefronts mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Plane wavefronts seedhe (flat) hote hain; spherical wavefronts point source se har taraf phailte hain.

book_ref.quote: For a point source in space, the wavefronts will always be spherical

rows: Seedhi satahein (drawing mein seedhi lakeerein).
Source ke gird kurwi satahein.
Plane source ya bohat door ke source se bante hain.
Teen-jihati jagah mein point source se bante hain.
Misal: door ke sitaron ki light.
Misal: qareebi point source ki awaz ya light.
Rays parallel hoti hain.
Rays har taraf phailti hain.

blocks.prompt:
12 What shapes of wavefronts are produced by a line source and by a point source?
(Line source aur point source kis shakal ke wavefronts banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Line source, jaise ripple tank ka seedha vibrator, do jihaton mein plane aur seedhe wavefronts deta hai. Point source do jihaton mein circular aur teen jihaton mein spherical wavefronts deta hai.

book_ref.quote: and spherical wavefronts in three dimensions as shown

blocks.prompt:
13 State Huygens' principle.
(Huygens ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Wavefront ka har point secondary wavelets (saanwi chhoti lehron) ka source hai jo lehar ki speed se har taraf phailte hain. Baad ke waqt ka naya wavefront in wavelets ko chhoone wali satah (envelope) hai.

book_ref.quote: every point of a wavefront may be considered the source of secondary wavelets

blocks.prompt:
14 How is the new wavefront CD found from the wavefront AB by Huygens' construction?
(Huygens ki banawat se wavefront AB se naya wavefront CD kaise maloom kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Speed v har jagah aik jaisi maan kar, t waqt mein wavefront vt chalta hai. AB par markaz rakh kar vt radius ke daire banaye jate hain; in ka envelope (mushtarka tangent) naya wavefront CD hai.

book_ref.quote: We construct several circles (traces of spherical wavelets) with radius vt, centered at points along AB.

blocks.prompt:
15 Light travels in water at 2.25 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. What radius of Huygens' wavelets is drawn to find the wavefront 8.0 ns later?
(Paani mein light 2.25 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ se chalti hai. 8.0 ns baad ka wavefront maloom karne ke liye wavelets ka radius kitna liya jayega?)

book_ref.quote: Then in time t the wavefront travels a distance vt.

blocks.prompt:
16 If Maxwell's equations give the same results, why is Huygens' principle still used?
(Agar Maxwell's equations wahi nataij deti hain to Huygens ka usool kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Huygens ke usool ke sab nataij Maxwell's equations se bhi milte hain, magar Huygens ka saada geometrical model baad ke wavefront ki shakal nikalne ke liye kahin zyada asaan hai.

book_ref.quote: All the results that we obtain from Huygens' Principle can also be obtained from Maxwell's equations

blocks.prompt:
17 What are coherent sources? Give one example.
(Coherent sources kya hain? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Coherent (hum-aahang) sources aisi lehrein bhejte hain jin ka phase difference mustaqil ho; is ke liye frequency aik jaisi aur mustaqil chahiye. Misal: aik hi signal generator se jure do loudspeakers, ya aik laser se roshan do slits.

book_ref.quote: Coherent sources emit waves that have a constant phase difference.

blocks.prompt:
18 Why are two separate lasers of the same frequency not used as the two sources in a double-slit experiment?
(Double-slit tajurbe mein aik jaisi frequency ke do alag lasers kyun istemal nahi hote?)
blocks.explanation: Laser light bohat se alag alag bursts (jhatkon) se bani hoti hai. Do alag lasers ke bursts ka in phase rehna yaqeeni nahi, is liye woh coherent nahi aur pattern badalta rahega.

book_ref.quote: We cannot guarantee that these bursts from two lasers will always be in phase with one another.

blocks.prompt:
19 How are coherent light sources obtained in the double-slit experiment?
(Double-slit tajurbe mein coherent light sources kaise hasil kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik hi laser ki light ko do slits se taqseem kiya jata hai. Dono slits do coherent sources ban jati hain jo mustaqil in phase (ya mustaqil phase difference par) rehti hain.

book_ref.quote: This problem is overcome by using a single laser and dividing its light using the two slits

blocks.prompt:
20 What would be heard if two loudspeakers were connected to different signal generators of slightly different frequencies?
(Agar do loudspeakers thori mukhtalif frequency wale alag signal generators se jure hon to kya sunai dega?)
blocks.explanation: Lehrein shuru mein in phase hon magar jald out of phase ho jayengi. Awaz tez, phir halki, phir tez hogi aur interference pattern kamre mein jagah badalta rahega.

book_ref.quote: If they were connected to different signal generators with slightly different frequencies

blocks.prompt:
21 What would be seen on the screen if the two light sources were not coherent?
(Agar do light sources coherent na hon to screen par kya nazar aayega?)
blocks.explanation: Interference pattern itni tezi se badlega ke aankh pakar nahi sakti. Sirf roshni ki yaksaan patti nazar aayegi, koi wazeh roshan aur andheri jagah nahi.

book_ref.quote: We would simply see a uniform band of light, without any definite bright and dark regions.

blocks.prompt:
22 Give two everyday examples of interference of light.
(Light ke interference ki do rozmarra misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Dhundli raat mein street lamps ya chaand ke gird roshni ke halay. (2) Kapre ke aar paar tez roshni ko dekhne par roshan aur andheri pattiyan.

book_ref.quote: you may have noticed haloes of light around street lamps or the Moon on a foggy night

blocks.prompt:
23 Waves reach us from all directions. Why do we not observe interference patterns all the time?
(Lehrein har taraf se hum tak pohnchti hain. Hum har waqt interference patterns kyun nahi dekhte?)
blocks.explanation: Interference ke liye mustaqil phase difference wale coherent sources chahiyein. Aam sources coherent nahi hote, is liye pattern itni tezi se badalta hai ke nazar nahi aata; naapne ke qabil interference ke liye khaas intezam chahiye.

book_ref.quote: So, why do we not observe interference patterns all the time?

blocks.prompt:
24 Define interference of waves.
(Lehron ke interference ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab do coherent lehrein kisi ilaqe mein milti hain to kuch points par aik doosre ko mazboot aur kuch par khatam karti hain. Bannay wala pattern interference (madakhilat) kehlata hai; yeh superposition ke usool se samjha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Two coherent waves, when meet in a region, they reinforce each other at some points

blocks.prompt:
25 State the basic conditions for two waves to produce interference.
(Do lehron ke interference ke liye bunyadi sharait likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Lehrein aik hi qisam ki hon (awaz ke saath awaz). (2) Coherent hon, yani phase difference mustaqil ho. (3) Aik hi ya taqreeban aik hi simt mein chalein.

book_ref.quote: The basic conditions for two waves to produce interference are

blocks.prompt:
26 Differentiate between constructive and destructive interference.
(Constructive aur destructive interference mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Constructive: lehrein in phase mil kar mazboot hoti hain; destructive: antiphase mein mil kar khatam hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: At some points, the two waves arrive in phase (in step) with one another and with equal amplitude

rows: Lehrein in phase pohnchti hain.
Lehrein antiphase (180° phase difference) mein pohnchti hain.
Path difference = mλ (poore wavelengths).
Path difference = (m + ½)λ (aadhe-adad wavelengths).
Barabar amplitude se aik lehar ka dugna amplitude.
Barabar amplitude mukammal khatam.
Roshan fringe (light) ya tez awaz.
Andheri fringe (light) ya halki awaz.

blocks.prompt:
27 Two waves of amplitudes 3 mm and 5 mm meet in phase at a point. Find the resultant amplitude. What is the resultant if two waves of 4 mm each meet in antiphase?
(3 mm aur 5 mm amplitude ki do lehrein aik point par in phase milti hain. Resultant amplitude nikalein. Agar 4 mm ki do lehrein antiphase mein milein to resultant kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Superposition se in phase: 3 + 5 = 8 mm (constructive). Barabar amplitude antiphase mein: 4 − 4 = 0 (destructive).

book_ref.quote: The principle of superposition predicts that the resultant wave has twice the amplitude of a single wave.

blocks.prompt:
28 Can two waves of different amplitudes produce interference? What is the effect on the pattern?
(Kya mukhtalif amplitude ki do lehrein interference kar sakti hain? Pattern par kya asar hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Mukhtalif amplitude ki lehrein bhi interference karti hain, magar andheri jagahein mukammal andheri nahi hotin, is liye roshan aur andheri jaghon ka contrast (farq) kam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Two waves can produce interference if amplitudes are different but this will decrease the contrast

blocks.prompt:
29 How can we show that light reaches the screen from both slits in the two-slit laser experiment?
(Do-slit laser tajurbe mein kaise dikhaya ja sakta hai ke light dono slits se screen tak pohnch rahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik andheri fringe par nishan lagayein aur aik slit dhaanp dein. Fringes ghaib ho kar chauri roshni ki patti aati hai aur andhera point roshan ho jata hai. Yani andheri fringe par dono slits ki light aik doosre ko khatam kar rahi thi.

book_ref.quote: carefully cover up one of the slits so that light from the laser is only passing through one slit

blocks.prompt:
30 Why is a laser more convenient than a bright bulb for the double-slit experiment?
(Double-slit tajurbe ke liye laser tez bulb se zyada asaan kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tez bulb se bhi milte julte nataij milte hain, magar laser apni light ko tang aur zyada tez beam mein markooz karta hai aur us ki light coherent hai, is liye fringes roshan aur saaf hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: a laser is much more convenient because the light is concentrated into a narrow, more intense beam

blocks.prompt:
31 Describe briefly how interference of microwaves is shown.
(Microwaves ka interference kaise dikhaya jata hai, mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: 2.8 cm ka microwave transmitter metal ki deewar ke do gaps ki taraf hota hai. Lehrein dono gaps par diffract ho kar aage milti hain. Probe receiver ko hila kar zyada intensity (constructive) aur kam intensity (destructive) ki jagahein milti hain.

book_ref.quote: The microwave transmitter is directed towards the double gap in a metal barrier.

blocks.prompt:
32 In the 2.8 cm microwave experiment, the probe is at a point where the path difference from the two gaps is 7.0 cm. Will it detect high or low intensity?
(2.8 cm microwave tajurbe mein probe aise point par hai jahan do gaps se path difference 7.0 cm hai. Kya woh zyada intensity dekhega ya kam?)
blocks.explanation: Path difference / λ = 7.0/2.8 = 2.5, aadhe-adad wavelengths. Is liye destructive interference: kam intensity.

book_ref.quote: By moving the probe around, it is possible to detect regions of high intensity

blocks.prompt:
33 How is the intensity detected by the probe made visible or audible?
(Probe ki pakri hui intensity ko dekhne ya sunne ke qabil kaise banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Probe receiver ko meter se jora ja sakta hai jo intensity dikhata hai, ya audio amplifier aur loudspeaker se jo sunai dene wala output deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The probe may be connected to a meter, or to an audio amplifier and loudspeaker to give an audible output.

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is a bright fringe formed at the point on the screen directly opposite the midpoint of the two slits?
(Screen par dono slits ke beech ke bilkul saamne wale point par roshan fringe kyun banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh point dono slits se barabar door hai, is liye path difference sifar hai. In phase nikli lehrein in phase pohnchti hain aur constructive interference se roshan fringe banti hai.

book_ref.quote: This point is directly opposite the midpoint of the slits.

blocks.prompt:
35 Why is the first dark fringe formed at point B? Find the path difference there for light of wavelength 560 nm.
(Point B par pehli andheri fringe kyun banti hai? 560 nm ki light ke liye wahan path difference nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: B par dono rays antiphase (180°) mein hain kyunke path difference aadhi wavelength hai, is liye destructive interference hota hai. Path difference = λ/2 = 280 nm.

book_ref.quote: The path difference between the two rays of light must be half a wavelength

blocks.prompt:
36 What is the path difference at the centre of the first bright fringe beside the central one (point C)? Why is it bright?
(Markazi ke saath wali pehli roshan fringe ke beech (point C) par path difference kya hai? Yeh roshan kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: C par ray 1 aik poori wavelength λ zyada chalti hai. Rays in phase pohnchti hain aur constructive interference se roshan fringe banti hai.

book_ref.quote: this time, it has travelled an extra distance equal to a whole wavelength

blocks.prompt:
37 What assumption is made to obtain r₂ − r₁ = d sin θ in Young's experiment?
(Young ke tajurbe mein r₂ − r₁ = d sin θ hasil karne ke liye kya farz kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slits se screen ka faasla L, slits ke faasle d se bohat bara ho (chand mm ke muqable mein aik metre ya zyada). Tab S₁ aur S₂ se P tak lakeerein taqreeban parallel hoti hain aur path difference d sin θ hota hai.

book_ref.quote: we assume that the distance L from the slits to the screen is so large

blocks.prompt:
38 What is needed to observe interference in Young's experiment, and how is it achieved today?
(Young ke tajurbe mein interference dekhne ke liye kya zaroori hai, aur aaj kal yeh kaise hasil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Coherent lehron ke do set chahiyein: mustaqil phase difference aur aik jaisi wavelength. Aaj kal aik laser beam do slits se guzari jati hai; har slit par light diffract ho kar screen par dono set milte hain.

book_ref.quote: In order to observe interference, we need two sets of waves.

blocks.prompt:
39 Write the conditions for bright and dark fringes in the two-slit experiment.
(Do-slit tajurbe mein roshan aur andheri fringes ki sharait likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Roshan (constructive): d sin θ = mλ, m = 0, 1, 2, 3, … Andheri (destructive): d sin θ = (m + ½)λ, m = 0, 1, 2, 3, … d slits ka faasla aur θ normal se angle hai.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, destructive interference (cancellation) occurs, forming dark regions on the screen

blocks.prompt:
40 Why is yₘ = L sin θₘ used instead of yₘ = L tan θₘ, and is it exact?
(yₘ = L tan θₘ ki jagah yₘ = L sin θₘ kyun istemal hota hai, aur kya yeh bilkul durust hai?)
blocks.explanation: yₘ, L se bohat chhota hai, is liye θₘ bohat chhota aur sin θₘ ≈ tan θₘ. Is liye yₘ = L sin θₘ bilkul durust nahi; yeh chhote angles ke liye taqreebi natija hai.

book_ref.quote: In such experiments, the distances yₘ are often much smaller than the distance L

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: sin aur tan sirf chhote angle par taqreeban barabar hain (maslan 1° par dono taqreeban 0.0175). Bare angle par farq wazeh ho jata hai, is liye formula yₘ = mLλ/d sirf markaz ke qareeb ki fringes ke liye theek hai.

blocks.prompt:
41 Write the formula for fringe spacing. How does it depend on the slit separation?
(Fringe spacing ka formula likhein. Yeh slits ke faasle par kaise munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Δy = Lλ/d. Spacing d ke ulat mutanasib hai: slits jitni qareeb, pattern utna phaila hua; slits door hon to pattiyan qareeb qareeb hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: The distance between adjacent bright bands in the pattern is inversely proportional to the distance d

blocks.prompt:
42 Yellow light of wavelength 590 nm falls on two slits 0.25 mm apart. Find the fringe spacing on a screen 1.0 m away.
(590 nm ki peeli light 0.25 mm door do slits par parti hai. 1.0 m door screen par fringe spacing nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The distance between centers of

blocks.prompt:
43 Light of wavelength 420 nm falls on slits 0.21 mm apart; the screen is 1.5 m away. How far from the centre is the 3rd bright band?
(420 nm ki light 0.21 mm door slits par parti hai; screen 1.5 m door hai. Teesra roshan band markaz se kitna door hai?)

book_ref.quote: positions of mth bright band is given by

blocks.prompt:
44 In a two-slit experiment with d = 0.50 mm and L = 1.5 m, the fringe spacing is 1.8 mm. Find the wavelength.
(Do-slit tajurbe mein d = 0.50 mm aur L = 1.5 m par fringe spacing 1.8 mm hai. Wavelength nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: When the slits are far apart, the bands in the pattern are closer together.

blocks.prompt:
45 With light of wavelength 630 nm and a screen 2.0 m from two slits, the 5th bright band is 21 mm from the centre. Find the slit separation.
(630 nm ki light aur slits se 2.0 m door screen par 5th roshan band markaz se 21 mm door hai. Slits ka faasla nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: yₘ = mLλ/d, is liye d = mLλ/yₘ = 5 × 2.0 × 630 × 10⁻⁹ / 21 × 10⁻³ = 0.30 mm.

book_ref.quote: Let yₘ be the distance from the center of the pattern

blocks.prompt:
46 Light of wavelength 600 nm falls on two slits 0.30 mm apart. At what angle is the first dark fringe (m = 0)?
(600 nm ki light 0.30 mm door do slits par parti hai. Pehli andheri fringe (m = 0) kis angle par hai?)

book_ref.quote: at points for which the path difference is a half-integer number (m + ½) of wavelengths

blocks.prompt:
47 Are the two-slit fringe equations true only for light? Explain.
(Kya do-slit fringe ki equations sirf light ke liye hain? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Yeh har qisam ki lehar (awaz, microwaves, paani ki lehrein) ke liye durust hain, basharte do coherent sources ka natija d ke muqable mein door dekha jaye.

book_ref.quote: the results given in Equation are valid for any type of wave

blocks.prompt:
48 Differentiate between bright and dark fringes in Young's experiment.
(Young ke tajurbe mein roshan aur andheri fringes mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Roshan fringes constructive aur andheri fringes destructive interference se banti hain.

book_ref.quote: Thus, the pattern on the screen of Fig. 15.9 is a succession of bright and dark bands

rows: Constructive interference (taqwiyat).
Destructive interference (khatma).
Path difference d sin θ = mλ.
Path difference d sin θ = (m + ½)λ.
Lehrein in phase pohnchti hain.
Lehrein antiphase (180°) mein pohnchti hain.
Pattern ka markaz (θ = 0) roshan hai.
Pehli andheri fringe path difference λ/2 par hai.

blocks.prompt:
49 Which two reflected waves interfere in a thin film of thickness t?
(t motai ki patli film mein kaun si do reflect hui lehrein interference karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik lehar upar ki satah se reflect hoti hai (path abc). Doosri upar ki satah se guzar kar neeche ki satah se reflect hoti hai (path abdef). Dono reflect hui lehrein aankh par mil kar interference karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Light shining on the upper surface of a thin film with thickness t is partly reflected at the upper surface

blocks.prompt:
50 Why does a thin film in white light show different colours at different places?
(Safaid light mein patli film mukhtalif jaghon par mukhtalif rang kyun dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har rang ki wavelength alag hai, is liye aik motai par kuch rangon ka constructive aur kuch ka destructive interference hota hai. Film ki motai jagah jagah badalti hai, is liye rang pecheeda patterns banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Different colors have different wavelengths, so the interference may be constructive for some colors

blocks.prompt:
51 For an air wedge between two glass plates at nearly normal incidence, what is the path difference, and where would bright and dark fringes be expected from path difference alone?
(Do sheeshe ki plates ke darmiyan air wedge mein taqreeban amoodi incidence par path difference kya hai, aur sirf path difference se roshan aur andheri fringes kahan honi chahiyein?)
blocks.explanation: Path difference = 2t, air wedge ki motai ka dugna. Sirf path difference se: jahan 2t poore wavelengths ho wahan roshan, jahan aadhe-adad wavelengths ho wahan andhera.

book_ref.quote: The path difference between the two waves is just twice the thickness t of the air wedge at each point.

blocks.prompt:
52 What is actually observed in the air-wedge experiment, and what does it show?
(Air-wedge tajurbe mein asal mein kya nazar aata hai, aur is se kya pata chalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roshan aur andheri fringes ulat jati hain: milne ki line andheri hoti hai, roshan nahi. Is se pata chalta hai ke aik reflect hui lehar mein aadhe cycle ka phase shift hota hai, jo Maxwell's equations se bhi maloom hota hai.

book_ref.quote: When we carry out the experiment, the bright and dark fringes appear, but they are interchanged!

blocks.prompt:
53 Light of wavelength 600 nm falls normally on an air wedge. At a point the thickness is such that 2t = 4λ. Find t and state whether the point is bright or dark.
(600 nm ki light air wedge par amoodan parti hai. Aik point par motai aisi hai ke 2t = 4λ. t nikalein aur batayein ke point roshan hai ya andhera.)
blocks.explanation: t = 4λ/2 = 2 × 600 = 1200 nm = 1.2 μm. Aadhe cycle ke phase shift se fringes ulat jati hain, is liye jahan 2t poore wavelengths ho wahan andhera hota hai.

book_ref.quote: In that case the two waves that are reflected at the line of contact are a half-cycle out of phase

blocks.prompt:
54 What are Newton's rings? How are they formed?
(Newton's rings kya hain? Kaise bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Plano-convex lens ko flat sheeshe ki plate par rakhne se un ke darmiyan hawa ki patli film banti hai. Is film ki upar aur neeche ki satah se reflect hui monochromatic light interference kar ke gol roshan aur andheri fringes banati hai: Newton's rings.

book_ref.quote: Newton's rings are formed when a plano-convex lens is placed on a flat glass plate

blocks.prompt:
55 Write three uses of Newton's rings.
(Newton's rings ke teen istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Monochromatic light ki wavelength nikalna. (2) Lenses ka radius of curvature maloom karna. (3) Precision optics mein satah ki be-qaidgiyan (irregularities) pakarna.

book_ref.quote: Newton's Rings can be used to calculate the wavelength of monochromatic light

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between the fringes of an air wedge and Newton's rings.
(Air wedge ki fringes aur Newton's rings mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono hawa ki patli film se banti hain; film ki shakal fringes ki shakal tay karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Fig 15.14 shows the convex surface of a lens in contact with a plane glass plate.

rows: Do seedhi sheeshe ki plates ke darmiyan hawa ki film.
Lens ki convex satah aur plane plate ke darmiyan hawa ki film.
Fringes milne ki line ke parallel seedhi pattiyan.
Fringes milne ke point ke gird daire.
Milne ki line andheri hoti hai.
Milne ka point rings ke markaz par hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
57 Why is monochromatic light, such as a sodium lamp, used to observe Newton's rings?
(Newton's rings dekhne ke liye monochromatic light, jaise sodium lamp, kyun istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Interference constructive hai ya destructive, yeh wavelength par munhasir hai. Aik wavelength se har motai par wazeh roshan ya andheri ring banti hai, is liye saaf gol fringes nazar aati hain.

book_ref.quote: When we view the setup with monochromatic light, you see circular interference fringes

blocks.prompt:
58 Define diffraction of light.
(Light ke diffraction ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Rukawat ke gird light ka murna aur light ki lehron ka rukawat ke geometrical saaye mein phailna diffraction (inheraaf) kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: The property of bending of light around obstacles and spreading of light waves into the geometrical shadow

blocks.prompt:
59 What is a diffraction grating? What is meant by grating spacing?
(Diffraction grating kya hai? Grating spacing se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diffraction grating barabar faasle wali bohat si parallel slits ki tarteeb hai. Grating spacing d saath wali slits ke markazon ka faasla hai; yeh fi unit lambai slits ki tadaad ka ulta (reciprocal) hai.

book_ref.quote: An array of a large number of parallel slits

blocks.prompt:
60 How are diffraction gratings made?
(Diffraction gratings kaise banayi jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli grating Fraunhofer ne bareek taaron se banayi. Gratings diamond ki nok se sheeshe ya metal par barabar faasle ki lakeerein khurach kar, ya kaali safaid pattiyon ke pattern ki photographic reduction se banti hain.

book_ref.quote: Gratings can be made by using a diamond point to scratch many equally spaced grooves

blocks.prompt:
61 Write the grating equation and explain its symbols.
(Grating equation likhein aur us ki alamaat ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: d sin θ = nλ, n = 0, ±1, ±2, … d grating spacing, θ seedhe rukh se maximum ka angle, n order aur λ wavelength hai. Yeh wahan lagta hai jahan saath wali slits ka path difference poore wavelengths ho.

book_ref.quote: So the positions of the maxima are once again.

blocks.prompt:
62 What are first-order and second-order lines of a grating?
(Grating ki first-order aur second-order lines kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: d sin θ = nλ mein n = ±1 wali lines first-order aur n = ±2 wali second-order lines hain. n = 0 wala maximum seedha aage hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The n = ±1 lines are called the first-order lines, the n = ±2 lines the second-order lines

blocks.prompt:
63 A grating has 600 lines per mm. Find the angle of the first-order maximum for light of wavelength 550 nm.
(Grating mein 600 lines per mm hain. 550 nm ki light ke liye first-order maximum ka angle nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the value of d is the reciprocal of the number of slits per unit length

blocks.prompt:
64 What is the highest order seen with a grating of 300 lines per mm for light of wavelength 650 nm?
(300 lines per mm wali grating aur 650 nm light se sab se ooncha order kaun sa dikhega?)
blocks.explanation: d = 3.33 × 10⁻⁶ m. sin θ ≤ 1, is liye n ≤ d/λ = 5.1. Sab se ooncha order = 5.

book_ref.quote: As Eq. (15.7) shows, the sines of the deviation angles of the maxima are proportional to the ratio

blocks.prompt:
65 Light of wavelength 500 nm gives a second-order maximum at 30° with a grating. Find the number of lines per mm.
(500 nm ki light aik grating se second-order maximum 30° par deti hai. Lines per mm nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: d = nλ/sin θ = 2 × 500 / 0.5 = 2000 nm = 2.0 × 10⁻³ mm. Lines per mm = 1/d = 500 per mm.

book_ref.quote: the pattern is a series of very sharp lines at angles determined by this formula

blocks.prompt:
66 What is seen when a grating is illuminated by white light?
(Grating par safaid light dalne se kya nazar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har order n aik musalsal spectrum deta hai. sin θ = nλ/d, is liye lambi wavelengths (laal) zyada angle par aur chhoti (neeli) kam angle par hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: If the grating is illuminated by white light with a continuous distribution of wavelengths

blocks.prompt:
67 What are far-field (Fraunhofer) conditions for a grating?
(Grating ke liye far-field (Fraunhofer) halaat kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Screen grating se itni door ho ke grating se screen ke aik point ki taraf jaane wali tamam rays parallel maani ja sakein.

book_ref.quote: We assume far-field (Fraunhofer) conditions

blocks.prompt:
68 Differentiate between the patterns of a double slit and a diffraction grating of the same slit spacing.
(Aik hi slit spacing wali double slit aur diffraction grating ke patterns mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Maxima aik hi simton mein hain, magar grating ke maxima bohat tang hain.

book_ref.quote: The principal intensity maxima with multiple slits occur in the same directions as for the two-slit pattern.

rows: Do slits.
Bohat si slits (saikron ya hazaron).
Maxima jahan d sin θ = mλ.
Maxima unhi simton mein, d sin θ = nλ.
Chauri roshan fringes.
Bohat tez (sharp), tang lines.
Wavelength kam durustgi se naapi jati hai.
Wavelength bohat zyada durustgi se naapi jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
69 Why is a crystal, and not an ordinary ruled grating, used to diffract X-rays?
(X-rays ke diffraction ke liye aam grating ki jagah crystal kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diffraction ke liye grating spacing wavelength ke hum-paimana chahiye. X-rays ki λ ≈ 10⁻¹⁰ m hai, jo aam grating ki spacing se bohat chhoti hai. Crystal ke atoms ki baqaida tarteeb ≈ 10⁻¹⁰ m spacing ki qudrati grating hai.

book_ref.quote: In order to observe the effects of diffraction, the grating spacing must be of the order of the wavelength

blocks.prompt:
70 State Bragg's equation and explain its symbols.
(Bragg equation likhein aur us ki alamaat ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: 2d sin θ = nλ. d parallel atomi planes ka darmiyani faasla, θ X-ray beam ka planes se angle, n order of reflection aur λ X-ray ki wavelength hai. Yeh reflect hui beams ki taqwiyat ki shart hai.

book_ref.quote: The equation 15.8 is known as the Bragg equation.

blocks.prompt:
71 X-rays of wavelength 0.154 nm fall on crystal planes of spacing 0.282 nm. At what angle does first-order Bragg reflection occur?
(0.154 nm wavelength ki X-rays 0.282 nm spacing wale crystal planes par parti hain. Pehle order ka Bragg reflection kis angle par hoga?)

book_ref.quote: It can be used to determine interplanar spacing between similar parallel planes of a crystal

blocks.prompt:
72 X-rays of wavelength 0.12 nm give first-order Bragg reflection at 20°. Find the interplanar spacing.
(0.12 nm ki X-rays pehle order ka Bragg reflection 20° par deti hain. Interplanar spacing nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Suppose an X-rays beam is incident at an angle θ on one of the planes.

blocks.prompt:
73 What did W.H. Bragg and W.L. Bragg find about X-rays and crystals?
(W.H. Bragg aur W.L. Bragg ne X-rays aur crystals ke baare mein kya maloom kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Unhon ne maloom kiya ke monochromatic X-ray beam crystal plane se aise reflect hoti hai jaise plane aaina ho. Lagataar parallel atomi planes ki reflections tab mazboot hoti hain jab 2d sin θ = nλ.

book_ref.quote: They found that a monochromatic beam of X-rays was reflected from a crystal plane as if it acted like mirror.

blocks.prompt:
74 For the same crystal (d = 0.282 nm) and X-rays (λ = 0.154 nm), at what angle is the second-order reflection?
(Usi crystal (d = 0.282 nm) aur X-rays (λ = 0.154 nm) ke liye second-order reflection kis angle par hoga?)

book_ref.quote: The value of n is referred to as the order of reflection.

blocks.prompt:
75 Give two important uses of X-ray diffraction.
(X-ray diffraction ke do aham istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Maloom wavelength ki X-rays se crystals ki interplanar spacing aur atomi dhancha maloom karna. (2) Hemoglobin aur DNA ke double helix jaise hayatiyati aham molecules ka dhancha maloom karna.

book_ref.quote: X-rays diffraction has been very useful in determining the structure of biologically important molecules

blocks.prompt:
76 Differentiate between the grating equation and Bragg's equation.
(Grating equation aur Bragg equation mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono maxima ki sharait hain; grating slits aur light, Bragg atomi planes aur X-rays ke liye hai.

book_ref.quote: The effective path difference between the two reflected beams is 2d sinθ.

rows: d sin θ = nλ.
2d sin θ = nλ.
d = saath wali slits ke markazon ka faasla.
d = parallel atomi planes ka darmiyani faasla.
Saath wali slits ka path difference = d sin θ.
Saath wale planes se beams ka path difference = 2d sin θ.
Nazar aane wali light ke saath (d taqreeban 1000 nm).
X-rays ke saath (d taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m).
